description: EPS 1995 para 6(a) as amended by G.S.R. 609(E) w.e.f. 01-09-2014: a person who FIRST becomes a provident-fund member on or after 01-09-2014, and whose pay at that date EXCEEDS the pension ceiling of 15000.0000, was never admitted to the Pension Scheme. Hand derivation: the employee first became a member on 2020-06-01, which is on or after the cutoff, and the statutory wage 25000.0000 exceeds 15000.0000, so the exclusion bites: EPF wages 15000.0000 and EDLI wages 15000.0000 as usual, but EPS wages 0.0000 and EPS contribution 0.0000; employee 12% of 15000.0000 = 1800; the employer's WHOLE 12% of 15000.0000 = 1800 stays in the provident fund because there is no pension to divert it to. Diverting 1250 into a pension the member can never draw is the failure this pins.
